Yes,
Farmacias Benavides
distributes and sells home and wearable medical monitoring devices
, such as continuous/flash glucose monitors (like the FreeStyle Libre system), digital blood pressure monitors, and blood glucose meters.
Farmacias Benavides

At
Farmacias Benavides
, you can purchase standard blood glucose monitors and flash glucose monitoring systems like the
FreeStyle Libre 2 Sensor
, but
they do not stock smartwatches, wearable ECGs, or remote sleep-tracking/patient-monitoring wearables
Farmacias Benavides
Available Glucose Monitoring Options
Flash Monitoring Systems:
FreeStyle Libre 2 Sensor
(~$1,662 MXN) for scanning interstitial glucose levels.
Standard Blood Glucose Meters:
Traditional kits including
True Metrix
OneTouch Select Plus Flex
, and
Contour Plus Elite
ranging from $270 to $569 MXN.
In-Store Services:
Select locations provide basic physical glucose testing via their
Benamedic medical offices
Wearables and Smart Devices
Smartwatches & Wearable ECG:
Not sold in inventory.
Sleep Trackers & Remote Monitoring:
Not offered as retail products.
